items.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:158–188, an empty message or missing recipient skips scheduling without updating retryCount; increments occur only on a falsy provider result or an exception (lines 178–195). These reminders remain eligible for selection at lines 48–54 and evade the new retry-limit cleanup at lines 38–40, so the PR’s retry tracking leaves this failure path unbounded until scheduledDate.
